queries: SELECT d.legacy_object_path,d.content_sha256 FROM ingest.dataset_snapshot_documents l JOIN ingest.source_documents d ON d.id=l.document_id WHERE l.snapshot_id=%s ORDER BY d.legacy_object_path,d.content_sha256
SELECT id FROM ingest.sources WHERE code='pitchapi_saved'
SELECT id FROM ingest.source_datasets WHERE source_id=%s AND dataset_key='ligue1-two-seasons-normalized-comparison' AND contract_version=%s
SELECT a.route_kind,a.public_key FROM ingest.public_aliases_current a JOIN unnest(%s::text[],%s::text[]) w(kind,key) ON a.route_kind=w.kind AND a.public_key=w.key
SELECT a.public_key public_key,r.* FROM ingest.public_aliases_current a JOIN football.players r ON r.id=a.player_id WHERE a.route_kind=%s AND a.public_key=ANY(%s)
SELECT a.public_key public_key,r.* FROM ingest.public_aliases_current a JOIN football.teams r ON r.id=a.team_id WHERE a.route_kind=%s AND a.public_key=ANY(%s)
SELECT a.public_key public_key,r.* FROM ingest.public_aliases_current a JOIN football.matches_current r ON r.id=a.match_id WHERE a.route_kind=%s AND a.public_key=ANY(%s) AND r.source_id=%s

SELECT a.public_key public_key,p.* FROM ingest.public_aliases_current a JOIN football.player_profile_versions p ON p.id=a.profile_version_id JOIN ingest.source_records sr ON sr.id=p.source_record_id JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshot_documents sd ON sd.document_id=sr.document_id AND sd.snapshot_id=%s WHERE a.route_kind='profile' AND a.public_key=ANY(%s) AND p.source_id=%s

SELECT a.public_key match_key,b.public_key team_key,t.* FROM football.match_teams_current t JOIN ingest.public_aliases_current a ON a.route_kind='match' AND a.match_id=t.match_id JOIN ingest.public_aliases_current b ON b.route_kind='team' AND b.team_id=t.team_id JOIN ingest.source_records sr ON sr.id=t.source_record_id JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshot_documents sd ON sd.document_id=sr.document_id AND sd.snapshot_id=%s WHERE t.source_id=%s AND a.public_key=ANY(%s) AND b.public_key=ANY(%s)

SELECT r.external_key performance_key,s.* FROM football.player_match_stats_current s JOIN ingest.source_records r ON r.id=s.source_record_id JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshot_documents sd ON sd.document_id=r.document_id AND sd.snapshot_id=%s WHERE s.source_id=%s AND r.external_key=ANY(%s)

SELECT r.external_key performance_key,v.* FROM football.player_match_metric_values_current v JOIN ingest.source_records r ON r.id=v.source_record_id JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshot_documents sd ON sd.document_id=r.document_id AND sd.snapshot_id=%s WHERE v.source_id=%s AND r.external_key=ANY(%s) AND v.metric_code=ANY(%s)

SELECT r.id,r.locator,d.id document_id,d.legacy_object_path,d.content_sha256 FROM ingest.source_records r JOIN ingest.source_documents d ON d.id=r.document_id JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshot_documents sd ON sd.document_id=d.id AND sd.snapshot_id=%s WHERE r.source_id=%s
SELECT code FROM football.metric_definitions WHERE definition_version=%s
